newsitem.title: USA: Autocam Q3 net slips on start-up costs.
newsitem.headline: Autocam Q3 net slips on start-up costs.

text.p: Autocam Corp said Friday its earnings for the third quarter ended March 31 were affected by project start-up costs linked to new fuel system programs and lower margins for certain existing operations.

The precision-machined parts maker posted net income of $1.1 million, or $0.19 a share, compared to $1.5 million, or $0.25 a share in the same period a year ago. Revenues climbed to $16.1 million from $15.0 million in 1996.
Autocam said the company was forced to employ less-efficient manufacturing processes in order to meet customer demand for some of its engineered components, affecting operating margins.
The company expects margins for those programs to improve throughout the fourth quarter.
Autocam shares were up 3/8 Friday at 9-1/8.
